§6Lunar Cybernetic Armor§f

§aThe armor you build specifically to destroy it. DNT Nano Suit demands a full set as sacrifice.§f

Lunar Cybernetic Armor is a mid-to-late-game power armor set with 10 MHE capacity per piece and 10 kHE/t charge rate. It gives speed, jump boost, saturation, radiation resistance (93.69% reduction at full set), an integrated jetpack (winged chestplate variant), thermal sight, and an auditory Geiger counter.

§6Crafting§f: Lunar plating is forged at a Tier 4 anvil from weapon steel plates, starmetal ingots, and magnetized tungsten wire. Each armor piece is crafted on a crafting table using lunar plating plus starmetal base armor, desh motors, and circuit boards.

§6The catch§f: The entire set is consumed as a crafting ingredient for the §bDNT Nano Suit§f. You can't skip this step. Build it, wear it for a while if you want, then sacrifice it.

§ePS:§f If any piece runs out of charge while worn, you die instantly with the message 'forgot to charge their organs.' Keep them topped up.
